name: prompt-input
description: Modern AI prompt bar with voice waveform mode that animates into a circular send button when focused or typed into.

props.name: animate
props.description: Play sketch draw-in animations. Defaults to  `animate` (true).

props.name: bowing
props.description: How much straight lines bow/curve in rough.js.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Additional class name on the root container.

props.name: containerStyle
props.description: Additional inline styles on the root container.

props.name: fillStyle
props.description: Fill pattern when the shape has a fill color.

props.name: fillWeight
props.description: Weight/thickness of individual hatch lines inside patterned fills.

props.name: hachureAngle
props.description: Angle in degrees of hatch lines for patterned fills.

props.name: hachureGap
props.description: Spacing between hatch lines for patterned fills.

props.name: keepOpenOnBlur
props.description: Keep the send button visible even after the input loses focus.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show a loading spinner inside the send button.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Callback fired when the user submits (by pressing Enter or clicking Send).

props.name: onVoiceClick
props.description: Callback fired when the voice/waveform icon button is clicked.

props.name: roughness
props.description: Sketchiness intensity passed to rough.js. Higher values look messier.

props.name: seed
props.description: Locks the hand-drawn wobble. Omit to follow SketchSeedProvider or fixed-then-randomize.

props.name: sendIcon
props.description: Custom send button icon component.

props.name: showSendButton
props.description: Manually control send button visibility.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size preset.

props.name: sketchColor
props.description: Stroke (outline) color override. Falls back to theme ink.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Width of sketch strokes in pixels.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Component visual variant.
- `"solid"`: Sleek dark/light capsule pill and circular send button.
- `"sketch"`: Hand-drawn rough.js sketch borders.

props.name: voiceIcon
props.description: Custom voice waveform icon component.

example:
<PromptInput
  placeholder="Ask anything..."
  onSubmit={(text) => handleSend(text)}
  onVoiceClick={() => startVoiceMode()}
/>
